concepts.def: God taking human form in Jesus — fully God, fully human
Jesus' death on the cross by Roman execution
Jesus' death repairs the rift between God and humanity
Jesus rising from the dead on the third day
Jesus returning to heaven 40 days after resurrection
Saved by God's free gift, received through faith

walkthroughs.body_html:
The incarnation is God becoming human in Jesus.

John 1:14 — 'The Word became flesh and dwelt among us.' Jesus is fully God and fully human.

Christians celebrate this at Christmas — the birth of Jesus to Mary, conceived by the Holy Spirit.

Jesus was crucified under Pontius Pilate. For Christians this was not a defeat — it was atonement.

Sin had broken the relationship between humans and God. Jesus' death pays that debt and restores the link.

Romans 5:8 — 'While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.' Good Friday remembers this sacrifice.

On the third day Jesus rose from the dead — the resurrection (Easter Sunday). 40 days later he ascended to heaven.

The resurrection proves Jesus' victory over sin and death and gives hope of eternal life.

Ephesians 2:8 — 'By grace you have been saved through faith.' Salvation is a free gift, not earned by works alone.

numericals.q: According to the Bible, how many days after the resurrection did Jesus ascend to heaven?
numericals.hint: Same number as the days in the wilderness
